name: track_pose
description: Hand landmarks through a video, on the device: 21 per hand per frame (wrist, then each finger from its base joint to its tip), in source pixels and in metres. A hand is tracked from frame to frame; the palm detector looks for hands again only while fewer than hands are tracked. Frame i is at i / fps s. The first run downloads about 8 MB of models. kind body is not available yet.

output.description: { kind, fps, frameCount, size: [w, h], found: frames with a hand, frames: [{ t, hands: [{ id (kept while tracked), handedness: left | right, score, landmarks: [[x, y, z] x 21] in source px (z relative to the wrist, the scale of x), world: [[x, y, z] x 21] in metres }] }], model, notes }, or with out the path of that JSON

params.name: kind
params.description: hand. body is not available yet.

params.name: fps
params.description: Frames per second to sample. Default: the video's, at most 30.

params.name: pad
params.description: Black border around the frame for the palm detector, as a fraction of the long side. It finds hands that fill the frame or leave it.

params.name: min-presence
params.description: Lowest score, 0 to 1, at which a palm or a hand counts as found. Lower finds more, and more wrong ones.

params.name: smooth
params.description: one-euro: a One Euro filter per hand on landmarks and world. none: raw.

params.name: min-cutoff
params.description: One Euro cutoff in Hz for a still hand. Lower is smoother.

params.name: beta
params.description: One Euro: how much the cutoff rises with the hand's speed. Higher lags less.

params.name: out
params.description: Write the JSON here and print its path
